items: 1 Tbsp Sriracha or hot sauce (more to taste)

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Cook **2 cups basmati rice** according to the package instructions.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.body: Heat **2 Tbsp vegetable oil** in a medium skillet over medium-low heat. Add **1 large onion, diced fine**, season with salt and pepper, and cook for a few minutes, until the onions are soft and starting to turn golden.

steps.title: Add the curry and garlic
steps.body: Sprinkle in **2 tsp curry powder** and **2 cloves garlic, minced**, and stir, cooking for another minute or so.

steps.title: Add the stock and coconut milk
steps.body: Pour in **1 cup vegetable stock** and stir to scrape up all the brown bits in the pan. Add **1 × 13.5 oz can coconut milk**, **1 Tbsp honey** and a squirt of sriracha.

steps.title: Simmer the chickpeas
steps.body: Bring to a boil, add **2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed**, reduce the heat, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Adjust the seasoning
steps.body: Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding more salt, honey, or Sriracha (or lime juice, if using).
